purpose: Paired facade, zoning and massing design boards only; not runtime assets or validated architectural plans.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliverable: ONE clear game-house architectural concept sheet, landscape 3:2. This is a DESIGN BOARD with consistent exterior and floor plan, not a game screenshot. Reference image 1: Ethan Clark Palia House, use ONLY its architectural hierarchy of one strong central house plus two subordinate lateral wings with perpendicular roof ridge directions; NOT the windmill, tower, livestock, exact decorative pattern, huge scale or exact facade. Reference 2: existing game interior, preserve cozy timber arches, furniture scale and palette. Reference 3: prior game cottage concept, use the hand-painted cream plaster, substantial aged brown timber, muted blue-grey chunky tiles, rich restrained wood/stone/edge texture, leaf and feather motifs. New original cottage design. Main central front gable faces the viewer, its ridge runs north-south (front to back). BOTH smaller side wings have roof ridges running east-west (left-right), rotated 90 degrees relative to main ridge. From the FRONT we see the side wings' sloping roof planes/eaves, NOT three front-facing triangular gables. Side wings attach logically along main house side walls, lower eaves and ridges, share structural datums. Calm near-balanced architecture, slight functional differences only. NO forced random asymmetry. No whole-house rotation and no isometric beauty angle. Central entry is at the south/front wall; rear window and desk at north/back. Modest single-storey playable home, no second floor, no central tower or enormous attic windows. Central roof moderately pitched, a normal generous wall storey, not a huge roof on a squat shed. Main room roughly 6.4m wide x6.6m deep, wings roughly2.8m wide x4.6m deep each, centred along its sides and set back from entrance, indicative only. Front door human scale. Thick but plausible eaves, stone foundation, deep framed windows, light domestic greenery. Material detail is painterly and shaped: wood grain/knots and edge highlights, stone facet color changes, tile-edge wear, cream plaster variation, not flat color swatches or photoreal PBR. Composition: upper-left 60 percent: large straight FRONT exterior elevation with a slight downward game camera (~25 degrees), architecturally consistent. Upper-right: accurate simple TOP-DOWN floor plan of this same house, with north up, entry bottom, beds/furniture drawn legibly, wall gaps/doors clearly shown. Beneath: a smaller neutral-grey blockout thumbnail from the SAME frontal game angle, same building shape, including roof ridge direction arrows labelled N-S and E-W. Sparse clean pale parchment background, readable panel headings only 'FRONT', 'PLAN', 'MASSING', plus variant A or B. No invented measurements printed, no lengthy text paragraphs, no yard redesign. Roof directions MUST match across all three panels.
Variant A: compact SEMI-OPEN home. Central entry opens straight into one generous communal room with rug, tea table, hourglass to right, desk under rear window. Left wing is a cozy bed alcove with two pillows and a little companion nest, open to main room through a broad timber arch; right wing is a washbasin/wardrobe alcove through a second broad timber arch. No internal swinging doors or corridors. Arches/short partition walls give zoning while preserving one cozy shared room feeling. Roofs and wings are compact and nearly balanced, not a mansion. Exterior lower wing windows reflect actual alcoves. Label 'A'.
